reason: This touches core executor access-path machinery for `IndexReader` and `IndexLookUp` in `pkg/executor/distsql.go`/`detach.go`. Even with only two code paths changed, these are central read executors, and adding detach support can affect executor lifecycle, distributed scan behavior, ordering/handle lookup correctness, and runtime semantics across many queries. That is high enough blast radius to justify a focused deep review for Blocker/High issues.
